segments.content:
Chapter 231: 0228 The Customer is King

Amidst the flurry of phone calls, Xu Haibo grew a little worried and asked Chen Guiliang in a low voice, "Will Bian Guanyue's cousin be alright?"

"Actually, if something did happen, it wouldn't necessarily be a bad thing for her," Chen Guiliang said.

"Huh?" Xu Haibo didn't understand.

Chen Guiliang said, "She has too much of a temper, and she's still young. A small setback would do her good. But from the looks of it, she won't be facing any setbacks today."

This was the kind of thing Chen Guiliang would only say to Xu Haibo. He wasn't foolish enough to go and tell Qiao Na.

If he said too much, Qiao Na would find him too paternalistic.

Chen Guiliang had already called a lawyer for consultation. Qiao Na's situation was considered a minor offense; five days of detention and a 500 yuan fine was already the maximum penalty. While giving his statement, Chen Guiliang had insisted that the other party was the one who had repeatedly harassed a woman first. A lawyer was already on their way to the police station.

"Hello. Are you here to report a case?"

"Hello, Officer. I'm Qin Yuemin from Zhigao Law Firm. I was sent for by Mr. Chen Guiliang."

"Let's talk inside. The two parties are currently mediating."

When the station chief heard the lawyer's name, he was instantly speechless.

This lawyer was already famous before, but he'd become especially famous in the last two years, specializing in defending high-profile criminal cases. For a common brawl, was it really necessary to hire this kind of lawyer?

Besides, this was a police station.

Not a courthouse!

What could a lawyer even do here?

Chen Guiliang stood up to shake the lawyer's hand, then explained to the officer, "I don't understand the law, so I'd like to consult a lawyer."

Lawyer Qin had already been briefed on the details over the phone. He sat down and said, "I believe a five-day detention is an excessively harsh punishment."

The station chief said irritably, "First, we haven't officially issued a penalty yet. Second, this isn't a courthouse. The punishment is up to the police station. If you have any objections, you can apply for a review. Third, if you want to resolve this quickly, Lawyer Qin, you can actively participate in the mediation."

"I am willing to mediate. I request that the case be dropped."

Having just been chewed out by his superior, Luo Jun took the initiative to back down as soon as he hung up the phone.

Under the shocked gazes of his friends, Luo Jun first walked up to Bian Guanyue and bowed. "Ms. Bian, I'm sorry. I had too much to drink. I promise I won't bother you again. Please forgive me!"

"It's nothing." Bian Guanyue didn't want to drag the matter on either.

Luo Jun then walked over to Qiao Na. "This... um, miss. I'm sorry. I had too much to drink before, which caused a misunderstanding."

"Mm."

Qiao Na was in even less of a mood. She would rather be detained than have her elders intervene.

"No, Old Luo, did you get your brain scrambled from the fight?" one of his friends said.

Luo Jun thought to himself: It's more serious than having my brain scrambled.

Jones Lang LaSalle entered the Chengdu market in October of last year. Their business in property sales, leasing, and consulting had been developing quite smoothly so far.

But they had only just broken ground in property management, as many local real estate companies had their own property management firms. They were currently taking the high-end route, advertising their aristocratic British-style property management, but not many real estate companies were willing to entrust their properties to them.

Bian Jinsong was currently building a high-end residential community, and JLL was desperate to secure the property management contract for it. They had already negotiated several times and were close to signing.

He couldn't afford to offend anyone, especially not a future client!

As for who Chen Guiliang was? Luo Jun still had no idea. Even if he did, he wouldn't care; they had no business dealings with each other.

"Officer, please write up the mediation agreement. This was my fault," Luo Jun said to the policeman.

The station chief began to wonder who Bian Guanyue's parents were. He had also received a call just now, but it hadn't been very specific, only telling him to handle the matter impartially and make sure it was resolved properly.

The mediation agreement was drafted quickly, and both sides signed it promptly.

As Luo Jun and his friends walked toward the parking lot, his cronies kept asking what was going on.

Luo Jun sighed. "I'm being transferred back to Shanghai. The other party is in real estate. Only if I leave Chengdu will they be willing to sign with our company. If I stay in Chengdu, they won't hand over the property management of any of their future communities to our company."

"Haha, you're just unlucky, randomly pissing off a major client." One of his friends actually laughed.

The other two friends had similar reactions, a hint of schadenfreude in their tone.

If the pressure had come from somewhere else, they might have been indignant, perhaps even thinking of escalating the situation. But since it was a client, he could only chalk it up to bad luck.

"That woman's boyfriend is probably no simple character either," one of them suddenly said.

"How can you tell?"

"Haven't you heard of that Lawyer Qin's reputation? Damn, he's known in the streets as Chengdu's number one criminal lawyer."

"Never heard of him. If that's true, that guy is probably some rich second-generation kid."

"Could even be the scion of an official's family."

"Mediating like this is for the best. Saves a lot of trouble."

"Old Luo, you're being transferred back to Shanghai. You're not getting demoted, are you?"

"What do you think? Shit!"

Luo Jun was incredibly frustrated. He was just trying to pick up a girl at a bar. How did it turn into this?

"Jie, aren't you going to wait for them?" Bian Guanyue called out.

Qiao Na didn't look back. "No need."

Chen Guiliang was shaking hands with the lawyer. "Thank you for your trouble today, Lawyer Qin. Please give me your bank account number, I'll transfer the money tomorrow."

"There's no need," Qin Yuemin said with a smile. "I didn't do anything tonight. Let's just consider it making a friend. If Mr. Chen has any other cases in the future, you can come find me anytime."

"Thank you so much," Chen Guiliang said.

Even though he said no fee was necessary, Chen Guiliang would still have Yang Shuo send a gift over another day.

He couldn't let the man make the trip for nothing.

After seeing the lawyer off, Xu Haibo said, "I should head back to the university."

Chen Guiliang said, "It's so late. The dormitory will definitely be locked by the time you get back. I've already booked a hotel, one room for each of you, right near Jinli."

"Then I'll enjoy it for free!" Qin Shanshan said with a smile.

It seemed like Chen Guiliang hadn't done much earlier, but he had quietly arranged everything in advance.

Even if Bian Guanyue hadn't called her father, Chen Guiliang would have resolved tonight's matter himself.

It was also Chen Guiliang who persuaded Jiang Zhiming, Tan Weiwei, and the others to go back to the bar. Otherwise, they would have wanted to stay at the police station to wait for the result.

When trouble arose, someone had to be responsible for cleaning up the mess, and that person could only be Chen Guiliang.

"The matter is resolved. Sorry for the trouble," Chen Guiliang sent a text to Jiang Zhiming.

Jiang Zhiming replied in a second, "Glad it's resolved. It was our fault for not taking better care of you all."

Bian Guanyue, who had just hung up her phone, said to Chen Guiliang, "My dad and the others are almost here. Cars can't drive into the pedestrian street, so let's go wait for them at the entrance."

The group continued to stroll along the street and found a small shop at the entrance for a late-night snack.

Before long, Bian Jinsong arrived.

Bian Guanyue's stepmother, younger brother, and aunt were also with him.

Her uncle, Qiao Na's father, didn't come. He was expanding his business in Mianzhou and planned to build a residential community there next year.

"Are you hurt anywhere?" Bian Jinsong asked with concern.

"I'm not hurt," Bian Guanyue said.

Her aunt, Bian Yunhui, asked, "Where's Nana?"

Bian Guanyue said, "She already left."

"Sigh!" Bian Yunhui let out a sigh.

Bian Jinsong shook hands with Chen Guiliang and the others, asked for details about what happened and the outcome, and thanked these old classmates for taking care of his daughter.

Immediately after, Bian Jinsong had his driver take a gift to the police station to express his thanks.

"Let's get a late-night snack too," Bian Jinsong said to his wife and sister.

The couple appeared quite harmonious in public, showing no signs that they were going through a divorce.

Bian Guanyue's stepmother even warmly greeted Chen Guiliang, Xu Haibo, and the others, personally going to the next stall to order some barbecue.

Like her daughter Qiao Na, Bian Yunhui also had a very short haircut, and her words and actions were quite sharp and capable. She was probably a very assertive person!

She looked at Chen Guiliang curiously and said, "That Kaixin001 of yours, I have an account too. It seems to have changed its name recently. It's quite fun. I've even put in a few hundred yuan."

"Then you're a major client, Auntie. Not many people top up several hundred yuan on Hainei," Chen Guiliang said with a smile. "I'll toast you, Auntie."

Bian Guanyue's stepmother joked, "You can't just toast one auntie."

"My mistake. I'll have another one as a penalty," Chen Guiliang said.

His stepmother said, "I saw on the news some time ago that your company's valuation is 2.2 billion in RMB. I thought I'd misread it. It was absolutely terrifying!"

"2.2 billion?"

Bian Yunhui was taken aback.

She only knew that her niece's boyfriend was in the internet business and had received venture capital, making him very rich. She never imagined his company was valued at 2.2 billion yuan.

Chen Guiliang smiled, "That valuation is all fluff. Uncle Bian is the real-deal entrepreneur."

Bian Jinsong said with emotion, "We're getting old. We can't understand the times anymore."

The stepmother, who had been composed until now, finally couldn't help but say, "You've just gotten timid, too cautious in business. The real estate market is booming right now. If you're afraid of this and that, why even be in business? Others are snatching up land as fast as they can, while you're the only one dragging your feet."

Bian Jinsong just smiled, neither refuting nor explaining.

In truth, he didn't know if he was doing the right thing either, but his early experiences had made him increasingly cautious. The hotter the real estate market got, the more he worried about things going wrong.

Chen Guiliang buried his head in his food, not getting involved in the couple's conversation.

But Bian Jinsong asked, "Xiao Chen, what's your take on the real estate market?"

Chen Guiliang said, "It should still see rapid development for another decade or more. But it's good to be cautious; otherwise, it'll be hard to hit the brakes when the business gets too big. I estimate Sunac's capital chain is just about to break."

"Sunac's capital chain will break?" The stepmother was clearly skeptical.

In the real estate industry these past few years, Sunac was the one making the biggest waves. They had mastered the art of building an empire from nothing, and they proactively inflated land prices, which delighted local governments who extended one invitation after another.

As early as three years ago, Sunac had less than 1 billion in its own capital but was already shouldering tens of billions in outstanding land payments. Not only did they not rein it in, they doubled down, and then they ran into last year's macroeconomic controls.

The harder it was to sustain, the more high-profile Sunac became, giving off the impression that it was never short of money.

Bian Jinsong, however, chuckled. "You're not in the industry. How did you come to that conclusion?"

Chen Guiliang said, "If the problems weren't so massive, why would Sunac's investors let Sun Hongbin resume his position as chairman?"

The stepmother said, "It's precisely because Sun Hongbin has returned, reshuffled personnel, restructured assets, and scaled back operations that Sunac can pull through its difficulties. Sunac's problems were due to last year's state controls. The policy has already been relaxed now."

"Perhaps," Chen Guiliang didn't argue.

Sun Hongbin did indeed pull through his difficulties, because he still had Sunac China in his hands.

As for the original Sunac company, it was a good thing someone took it over, at least it didn't end up a complete mess like Evergrande.

As he ate and chatted with Chen Guiliang, Bian Jinsong felt that the more he talked to this young man, the more he liked him. What a pity, the young man had his own company, and his own temple was too small to house him.

After eating and drinking until past one in the morning, Bian Guanyue's elders finally left.

Early the next morning, while Chen Guiliang was still lying in bed, Qiao Na called Bian Guanyue. "Where are you guys?"

"A hotel," Bian Guanyue said.

"Which hotel? I'm coming over now. I want to discuss a business deal with your boyfriend. If he's not willing, I'll go find someone else."

(End of Chapter)
